methods.core_law: C[a:b]=((a^2-b^2)+J*2ab)/(a^2+b^2), J^2=-1, and C([a:b] star [c:d])=C[a:b]C[c:d] for [a:b] star [c:d]=[ac-bd:ad+bc]. If P^2-DQ^2=-1, tau=Qsqrt(D)-P is the exact Cayley coordinate of the normalized segment (P,1).
methods.hard_boundary: Derived character geometry only. It does not identify J with a native spatial axis, the unit-character conic with the native Enterprise metric plane, or a rational/projective segment state with every admissible Cell trajectory. The Cayley-product limit to exp(J theta) is standard analytic completion. No Driver review or shared-tool promotion is requested.
